Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer supplied an incorrect value for C, stating the average height of women in the Philippines as 154 cm. The July 2023 Business Insider article reports approximately 149.6 cm, which rounds to 150 cm. Using C=154 led to x = (4097 − 154) / (11 − 2·2) = 3943/7 ≈ 563.3 instead of the correct x = (4097 − 150) / 7 ≈ 563.9. Although the Orchestrator misdescribed the derivative in wording, the derivative used (4x) matched the correct derivative for A·x^2 with A=2 and did not cause the numerical error; the wrong C value is directly responsible for the incorrect final answer.
